items.headline: UN Nuclear Watchdog Board Refers Iran to Security Council
items.summary: The International Atomic Energy Agency's Board of Governors voted to report Iran to the United Nations Security Council for failing to comply with its nuclear non-proliferation obligations. This decision marks the first time in twenty years that the agency has formally referred Iran to the Security Council, escalating international diplomatic pressure over restricted access to nuclear sites.

items.headline: California Enacts New Laws Regulating AI Chatbots and Social Media Platforms
items.summary: California Governor Gavin Newsom signed a suite of 13 new state bills establishing tighter oversight for artificial intelligence and social media platforms. The landmark package includes measures requiring AI chatbot developers to implement strict age verification and default safety settings to protect underage users.

items.headline: Ben Shelton Dethrones Carlos Alcaraz in Historic US Open Quarterfinal Thriller
items.summary: American tennis player Ben Shelton defeated defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a dramatic five-set quarterfinal to advance to the US Open semifinals. Finishing at 3:33 a.m. local time, the marathon four-hour match set a record for the latest finish in tournament history.

items.headline: 51st Toronto International Film Festival Kicks Off with Major Premieres and First Dedicated Film Market
items.summary: The 51st Toronto International Film Festival officially opened on September 10, 2026, showcasing over 200 global films and launching its first dedicated official film market. Director Siân Heder's biographical drama "Being Heumann," centered on disability rights activist Judy Heumann, headlined the event as the opening night film.
